_comment: CFG-13. Model rates in US dollars per million tokens, used only by tools/export_to_langfuse.py to turn token counts into a cost estimate. Nothing in a run reads this file, and no run is stopped by it — the budget block in novel.config.json is advisory on this branch.
_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 2026-09-17. Rates change; this file is a snapshot a human pasted, not a live feed. If a cost in the dashboard looks wrong, check here first.
_comment_estimate: The orchestrator records ONE token figure per subagent call, because that is all the harness reports — there is no input/output split. Cost therefore cannot be computed, only bounded. assumed_input_share is the knob: 0.85 says treat 85% of a call's tokens as input, which is roughly right for this workload because every prompt carries the whole Story Bible and every reply is a few hundred words. The exporter sends the resulting estimate AND both bounds, so a reader can see how much of the number is arithmetic and how much is this assumption.
_comment_unknown: A model with no entry here is exported with its token count and no cost, rather than with a guessed rate. An absent cost is a gap a reader can see; a wrong one is not.
